title: UI风格#182 - Infographic Dark (信息图深色)
description: 创建第182种UI风格：信息图深色风格 - 数据可视化美学、深色背景、鲜明图表。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFZ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Infographic Dark style When color palette Then features data colors: cyan, magenta, yellow on dark navy
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#00D4FF (数据青), #FF006E (数据粉), #FFBE0B (数据黄), #0A1929 (深海军), #13294B (暗蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Infographic Dark style When typography Then uses data display: Barlow, DM Sans, or Space Grotesk
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Barlow (数据), DM Sans (清晰), Space Grotesk (技术)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Infographic Dark style When layout Then chart-centric layout, data card grids, metric dashboards
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：图表中心布局、数据卡片网格、指标仪表板

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Infographic Dark style When UI elements Then chart animations, data highlight, metric counters, progress rings
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：图表动画、数据高亮、指标计数器、进度环

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Infographic Dark UI When functional Then includes data chat, metric agents, insight stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：数据聊天、指标代理、洞察统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Infographic Dark UI When copy Then uses data terms: 'Data', 'Metric', 'Insight', 'Analytics'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'DATA. METRIC. INSIGHT.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'ANALYZE'、'DEPLOY'→'PROCESS'
